mapper.select: SELECT id, daily_report_id, author_type, author_id, content, created_at, updated_at FROM report_comments WHERE daily_report_id = #{dailyReportId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_comments (id, daily_report_id, author_type, author_id, content) VALUES (#{id}, #{dailyReportId}, #{authorType}, #{authorId}, #{content})
